contexts.text: Enjoyment on account of its use. Signified.
They who are in charity... do not regard the enjoyment of pleasures, except for the sake of use.
What is from the Lord... they enjoy with the whole sense.
Spirits are in the enjoyment of all goods as to all their senses...
He blessed them = the enjoyment of celestial and spiritual things. To bless = to enjoy all goods. They enjoy all goods who enjoy celestial and spiritual goods.
The enjoyment of goods by His internal man. Signified.
Thou shalt be buried in a good old age = the enjoyment of all goods by those who are the Lord's... (After the death of the body) those who are the Lord's first come into the enjoyment of all goods...
I will make him a great nation = the enjoyment of goods, and their increments.
To recline with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob = to enjoy celestial goods... For whether it is said to enjoy these celestial things, or whether it is said to enjoy the Lord, is the same thing...
Enjoyment so far as it is from good. Signified. To enjoy in so far as it is from good, here means, in so far as they know that it is good...
Preparation for the enjoyment (of the good of innocence) by all in general who are of the Spiritual Church. Signified.
Enjoyment. Signified. To eat = appropriation, but here enjoyment, because it treats of a state of initiation. Explained.
Enjoyment in a state of separation from the evil who have infested. Signified.
That thus they enjoyed the good of pleasures as much as they wanted. Signified.
The enjoyment of all good and truth as it were from proprium. Signified. To lay up the overplus until the morning = enjoyment on the Sabbath day... To eat = enjoyment and appropriation. AC 8498.
